# THE TRUE CAUSAL STATE OF THE ARRIVAL OBJECT.  All-session denominators throughout, 5 seeds, in-sweep shuffled nulls, and ONLY blind selectors on the deployable lines.

# LINE 1 IS THE RESULT.  The knob is chosen on the PREVIOUS era within its policy family and applied blind; the bar it is shown against is the GLOBAL null over the whole 528-cell search, which is the conservative choice — line 1a shows the same row against its own family's narrower bar.

# THE HONEST CAVEAT ON LINE 1: picking WHICH FAMILY to quote is itself a selection step taken after seeing all of them.  That is why the global bar is the one printed beside it, and why the cross-era consistency of the chain matters more than any single era's margin.
# THE LEAKY SECRETARY FAMILY IS ABSENT FROM THIS SEARCH, so it does not inflate the null the honest arms must clear.
